propositions: Pass-2 verification rejects all indices as unexpected when Plan-1 produces zero findings, degrading all findings to INDETERMINATE despite correct VERDICT
The contiguous-from-zero rejection pattern [0, 1, 2, 3, ...] occurs only on zero-finding runs, indicating an empty batch handled incorrectly by verify_instructions() rather than a model fault

verify_instructions() returns an imperative request ('Emit one verification per finding') for empty batches, causing the verifier to emit indices 0..N-1 against an empty index domain, triggering contract violation
INDETERMINATE findings from Pass-2 degradation cannot block gate decisions, so the violation silently produces unverified findings that pass, not spurious blocks
The fix changes verify_instructions() to return 'No findings to verify; return an empty verifications array.' for empty batches, mirroring the prerequisite_workflow_ops contract
